TITLE: Streaming
DESCRIPTION: Announces in Discord when a watched channel goes live

STREAMERS.TITLE: Watched channels
STREAMERS.SUBTITLE: Whoever goes live gets announced here
STREAMERS.EMPTY_HINT: Add a Twitch channel name. The streamer is not notified - being live is public information.

TARGETS.TITLE: Targets
TARGETS.SUBTITLE: Where the announcement goes and how it looks
TARGETS.ONAIR_HELP: Private voice channel of the stream crew. Stored, but currently has no effect: it is deliberately not shown in the announcement, so nobody is invited into a channel they cannot enter.
TARGETS.FILTER_TITLE: Only if the title contains this word
TARGETS.CLEANUP_EDIT: Turn the message into a recap
TARGETS.PROBE_MENTION_HINT: Unticked, the test stays silent. Ticked, it pings the role exactly like a real announcement. The recap never mentions anyone anyway.

TEMPLATES.TITLE: Templates
TEMPLATES.SUBTITLE: The text above the announcement
TEMPLATES.HINT: Plain text with placeholders. The card below has a fixed layout.

STATE.TITLE: Status
STATE.SUBTITLE: What is watched, when we last heard something, and what is stuck
STATE.NO_PROBLEMS: Nothing. All subscriptions active, no pending jobs.
STATE.LIVEFEED_OFF: Connection lost — figures may be stale
STATE.LIVEFEED_HINT: This page updates itself whenever something changes. If the connection drops, it says so here.

OPERATIONS.TITLE: Operations
OPERATIONS.SUBTITLE: Subscriptions, quota and credentials - across all guilds
OPERATIONS.SECRET_SET: set - not readable again for security reasons
OPERATIONS.CREDENTIALS_HELP: One application for the whole installation — the operator’s developer credentials, normally in the .env. Create it at dev.twitch.tv/console/apps. Individual guilds do not enter keys.
